announcements.body: Dear Year 6C, In three weeks (24 November), you will have your end of Unit test on mapping skills. I have attached a guidance sheet that explains the different levels and what you should aim for in this unit. There are two other steps that you should be taking: 1. Keep up to date with your class work. 2. Make sure you read your class notes and the summary notes in the textbook. 3. Complete the practice exercises in the textbook and on Google Classroom. 4. Ask for help if you need it. Kind regards, Mr Tse 附件：Guidance Sheet - Level Descriptors 2025-26.pdf

announcements.body: Dear all, Swimming lessons will start next week (6/11/2026). Please prepare your swimsuit, goggles, swim cap, towel, and a plastic bag for wet items. The first lesson will be on Friday, 6/11/2026, while the second lesson will be on Friday, 13/11/2026. announcements.title: Alexander the Great PEE Paragraph
announcements.body: Use your computers to research the details for Alexander the Great and find evidence for whether he was great or not. I will advise you to write an draft on your notebooks before writing it on your lined paper for submission. Let another classmate read it and mark it using the rubric. Formative/Question: To what extent was Alexander the Great ‘great’? Due date: November 11th, 2026
